system.description:
Self or touch; cast immediately after the target spell.

  • Makes Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Read Magic, See Invisibility, Tongues, Darkvision or Protection from Normal Missiles permanent on you, or Gust of Wind or Unseen Servant on a place or object.
  • Costs 1 point of Constitution (permanent; this is not drain, and only Wish or Miracle can restore it).
  • You can sustain 1 permanent spell per four levels.

Classes: Wizard
